name: ASu-skills
tagline: A Chinese-language job-hunting workflow for agents
description: ASu-skills is a Chinese-language workflow plugin for agents built around the job hunt: managing open-source contributions, polishing your resume, and running autumn recruitment (秋招) cycles. It packages practical, market-aware guidance into skills an agent can walk through step by step, so it functions as a structured assistant for candidates navigating the Chinese tech hiring season. It is part of a fast-growing non-English agent-skill ecosystem that is still largely under-covered in English-language coverage.
highlights: Covers the full job-hunt loop: contributions, resume, and autumn recruitment
Chinese-language workflow tuned to the local hiring market
Packaged as agent skills for step-by-step, structured guidance
A window into the fast-growing Chinese agent-skill ecosystem
curatorNote: The agent-skill gold rush is happening in languages most Western coverage ignores, and ASu-skills is a great example — a practical career workflow that large US audiences would never see. Worth watching for the broader trend it represents.
